text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this place is great! ♪ The<n>sunshine feels so
nice!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Just letting off some of steam bybreaking free of the normalday-to-day and having a littlevacance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a folding table with her, upon<n>which sits
some fruit and a tropical<n>drink. It looks like she's
enjoying a<n>proper vacation out here.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Nothing's going to plan...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you seem really troubled, El.<n>How about
we have a little<n>refresh-and-recharge together?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh... sorry. Right now, I just<n>wanna focus on my
running. I<n>haven't been in top form lately.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's all the more reason you need<n>a break! You
need to refill your<n>energy gauge if you want to face
your problems properly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Stretch out under the sun, and you'll<n>feel much
better! Now come over, lie<n>down, and reach your
arms toward<n>the sky!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Join us too, Trainer! Okay, you ready,<n>El? Let's do
this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Uh, like this?! Am I doing it right?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the spirit! Doesn't<n>feeling the
sunshine on your skin<n>just lift a huge weight off
your<n>shoulders?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's so toasty and warm! I feel like<n>I'm getting
bundled up in the scent of<n>the sun...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... All the tension's leaving mybody. Wow, I nearly forgot, but... es miamigo el sol...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right, just let all your stress<n>and worries go,
and enjoy a lovely<n>little holiday getaway under the
warm<n>sun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kentucky... How I miss your green<n>pastures!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, Taiki. Are you feeling<n>homesick? You
should try some deep<n>breathing exercises when
you're<n>feeling like that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Close your eyes and take in a deep<n>breath. Then,
let your body feel the<n>sun's heat and take in the
smell of<n>the flora around you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I suppose I could give it a try...Inhaaale... Huh? This smell...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's the scent of dazzlin' sunshine<n>and fresh green
grass! Wow! It really<n>feels like I'm in Kentucky!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You may be in a different country, but<n>you're under
the same sun! All right,<n>let's let loose and play like
we're<n>kids again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaw! Time to indulge ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's an imaginary vacance back<n>home! ♪ Let's run
wild under the<n>bright blue sky!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Seeking the Pearl, the two<n>of them
become fully immersed in<n>their vacations, escaping
their<n>everyday lives for the moment.
choice_data_list: I guess everyone is craving a little vacation time.
I guess everyone is craving a little vacation time.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Since we go full throttle every day,<n>our hearts can
get worn down before<n>we know it. That's why it's
important<n>to recover by resting as hard as we<n>can.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's what all-out vacances are for!<n>♪ So we can
stretch out our wings<n>and fully recharge our vitality!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We shouldn't hog this experience to<n>ourselves,
either. Let's invite some<n>other students to join in
on the fun!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Take a mini vacance and say bye-bye<n>to the stress
of your everyday lives. ♪<n>The time you take off
today will<n>become your energy for tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... This does feels nice. It's been<n>so long since
I cast my worries aside<n>and just sunbathed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fun activities are essential for a good<n>break too!
Let's strengthen our<n>bodies while we enjoy the
sunshine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The power of the sun is making my<n>punches cut
like the wind! Who thinks<n>they can take me? Bring it
on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, a huge group of<n>Umamusume has
gathered around us.<n>They all enjoy their a little
vacation in<n>their own way and savor their<n>temporary
escape from the ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, welcome to your mini<n>vacance! Forget
about the bustle of<n>life and make the most of today!
♪

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay! ♪ Vacations are the best!
choice_data_list: The relaxing effect of the sunshine sure is amazing.
The relaxing effect of the sunshine sure is amazing.
More and more students keep turning up!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay! ♪ Vacations are the best!
choice_data_list: The relaxing effect of the sunshine sure is amazing.
The relaxing effect of the sunshine sure is amazing.
More and more students keep turning up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! People tend to forget, but<n>the sun's
energy is very powerful!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's all about how you view the world.<n>Even a patch
of grass can turn into a<n>world-class bed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer! Let's dive into this<n>vacance! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone longs in the hearts to<n>escape their
everyday routine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Which is why it's my duty to propose<n>a break that
will open you up and help<n>you relax!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No doubt, there are still loads of<n>people in need of a
refresh!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep treating them to the best<n>relaxation they
could ask for!
